caption:
Sad anime that earn the tears: three picks for a night you want to cry on purpose.

Anohana does it in 11 episodes, Violet Evergarden takes 13 and lands every letter, and Clannad: After Story is the one your friends warned you about. Bonus for the brave: Grave of the Fireflies, one film, no recovery time.

Which anime broke you the hardest?

Save this for the next rainy night.
